description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractCommand implementing the Command interface, providing common functionality for command objects including JSON serialization, header validation, and equality checks within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AbstractCommand
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the Command interface, providing common logic for command objects including JSON serialization, header validation, and equality.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the command.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the manifest representation of the command, defaulting to its type.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the command.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the command to a JsonObject, including type and payload.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Abstract method to append command-specific payload to JSON builder.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on headers and type.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on headers and type.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equality check, confirms if other object can be equal.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the command.
